race.description: Crjc Christmas Race Day 29 November Mdn Plate
race.comment: WHO LOVES A HARLEY (8) improving gelding ready to peak fourth up. Gripped on late with the 59kg with a sound second over 1181m at this track. Should relish the extra ground and not without top three claims. INSAIN CHAOS (6) slashing return first-up, then shuffled back from the inside draw with a below-par seventh over 1210m at Lismore in a Super Maiden. Finds an easier race and placed at the trip from a wide draw on August 1. Leading contender. MISS FIC (12) improved at her second career start with a fast finishing third over 1181m at this track on the soft (6) surface. Looking for this trip and further now and gets her chance from the rails draw. BOBBIWAA (2) worked hard from the wide gate on resumption with a tiring fourth over 1181m at this track. Will relish the extra ground and improvement is anticipated.
